name: Susa
description: Susa, in the lower Zagros foothills of south-west Iran, is a cluster of ancient mounds beside the Shavur River, with the ruins of Ardeshir's palace on the opposite bank. People lived here continuously from the late 5th millennium BCE until the 13th century CE, so the excavated palaces, homes and administrative buildings lie stacked in layers. It preserves traces of Elamite, Persian and Parthian cultures.
